highlights.headline: Nuclear war and malicious use of AI threaten end of humanity by 2100, says Lancet assessment
highlights.summary: <p>Newly established commission identifies 17 catastrophic threats to human health but says ‘realistic route to act’ on each exists</p><p>Humans could become extinct by the year 2100 due to malicious use of AI or nuclear conflict, according to a new global risk assessment.</p><p>They top a list of 17 major threats to human health over the next 75 years, which also includes cuts to aid spending by wealthy countries, the climate crisis and childhood malnutrition.</

items.title: Palestinian president postpones elections until late 2027
items.description: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas previously committed to holding legislative elections in November 2026. He said that due to "obstacles ⁠posed by Israeli measures" the vote would be pushed back until late next year.

items.title: 'Ragebait' is the 2026 German Youth Word of the Year
items.description: Already named the 2025 Oxford Word of the Year, "rage bait" has also been widely adopted in German slang.

items.title: Eritrea urges UN deterrence measures against Ethiopia
items.description: Eritrea has officially requested UN Security Council assistance over the conflict in Tigray. Both Eritrea and Ethiopia accuse each other of fueling regional instability.
